newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai insurance premiums 5.8 bln yuan in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai insurance premiums 5.8 bln yuan in 1996.

text.p: Insurance premium income in China's economic hub Shanghai, reached 5.8 billion yuan ($698 million) last year, the Financial Morning Post said on Friday.
Of the total, income from life insurance accounted for 49.6 percent, and showing an average increase of 50 percent over the last two years, the newspaper said.
It estimated the per capita spending in Shanghai on life insurance was 534 yuan last year, double the amount in 1995 when China allowed life insurance to begin.
